content: भोज {%a.%} .²1 Bestowing enjoyment; राजा भोजो विराट् सम्राट् क्षत्रियो भूपतिर्नृपः <ls>Mb. 12. 68. 54</ls>. .²2 Leading a life of enjoyment, enjoying; देवासुरमनुष्येषु ये भजन्त्यशिवं शिवम् . प्रायस्ते धनिनो भोजाः <ls>Bhāg. 10. 88. 1</ls>. .²3 Liberal, bountiful.

भोजः [भुज्-अच्] <ab>N.</ab> of a celebrated king of Mālvā (or Dhārā); (supposed to have flourished about the end of the tenth or the beginning of the eleventh century, and to have been a great patron of Sanskrit learning; he is also supposed to have been the author of several learned works, such as सरस्वतीकण्ठाभरण <ab>&c.</ab>). .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of a country. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of a king of the Vidarbhas; भोजेन दूतो रघवे विसृष्टः <ls>R. 5. 39</ls>, <ls n="R.">7. 18</ls>, <ls n="R. 7.">29</ls>, <ls n="R. 7.">35</ls>. .{@-जाः@} ({%m.%} <ab>pl.</ab>) <ab>N.</ab> of a people.
